name: Glass Shield
shortDescription: Clear hard-coat sacrificial film that absorbs scratching, carving, and acid etching on Philadelphia glass — replaced in minutes, never the glass beneath.
description:
Glass Shield is Graffiti Shield's flagship sacrificial clear film for glass surfaces. Engineered with a specially formulated hard coat and optimal thickness, Glass Shield acts as a barrier against the three most common forms of glass vandalism in Philadelphia commercial environments: scratching, carving, and acid etching. When the film is damaged, it peels away cleanly and a fresh sheet is installed in minutes — restoring the glass to a pristine, like-new condition at a fraction of glass replacement cost.

For Philadelphia's South Street corridor, Old City storefronts, and SEPTA transit platforms, Glass Shield is the standard specification for ground-floor and street-level glass. The film is optically clear — it does not change the appearance, tint, or visible light transmission of the glass. Once installed, Glass Shield is essentially invisible in normal use; only vandalism makes it visible.

The economics are straightforward: a Glass Shield replacement costs a fraction of the glass procurement and installation it prevents. For Philadelphia properties that experience even one acid-etching or deep scratch incident per year, Glass Shield typically recovers its installation cost on the first prevented replacement. For properties on high-vandalism corridors — Market Street, Kensington Avenue, Passyunk, or near SEPTA transit hubs — the savings compound across multiple incidents.

Glass Shield is applied to the interior glass surface by Window Film Philadelphia's certified installation team. We assess glass type, dimensions, and surface condition before installation to ensure compatibility and optimal adhesion. The film can be removed at any time without adhesive residue.

benefits.heading: Absorbs Vandalism — Glass Is Never Replaced
benefits.body: When Glass Shield is scratched, carved, or acid-etched, only the film is damaged. The glass beneath remains pristine. The film peels away cleanly and a fresh sheet is installed — no glass procurement, no business closure, no lead time.

benefits.heading: Optically Clear — Invisible in Normal Use
benefits.body: Glass Shield does not affect visible light transmission, window appearance, or the view through your glass in any way. Customers, tenants, and visitors will not notice it is installed until it absorbs a vandalism incident.

benefits.heading: Fraction of Glass Replacement Cost
benefits.body: Film replacement costs dramatically less than glass procurement and installation. For Philadelphia properties facing recurring vandalism, Glass Shield typically pays for itself on the first prevented glass replacement.

name: Glass Shield Multi Layer
shortDescription: 4-layer 4-mil clear anti-graffiti system — peel one layer at a time as incidents occur, with continuous protection between replacements.
description:
Glass Shield Multi Layer is Graffiti Shield's most advanced system for Philadelphia properties that face frequent or ongoing vandalism. Rather than a single sacrificial film layer, the system stacks four 4-mil clear anti-graffiti films precisely custom-cut to fit your glass. When the surface incurs damage, only the affected top layer is peeled away — the remaining three layers continue protecting the glass below. No service call is required between incidents. No full re-installation. No glass exposed between replacements.

For SEPTA platform barriers, Philadelphia transit station glass, and ground-floor storefront windows on corridors with documented recurring vandalism — Market Street, Kensington Avenue, South Street, near 30th Street Station — Glass Shield Multi Layer is the highest-endurance option available. The system installs once and manages repeated vandalism events over the full lifespan of the four-layer stack.

The cost model is fundamentally different from single-layer Glass Shield: instead of a service call after each incident, the facility responds immediately by peeling the top layer on-site, with no outside contractor required. For a transit authority facility experiencing 6-10 incidents per year, this eliminates the scheduling overhead and per-incident response cost that makes standard glass film maintenance unsustainable at scale.

Each layer is precision-cut to your exact glass dimensions by Graffiti Shield's in-house pre-cut program. The stack lies flush against the glass with no visible gap between layers in normal lighting.

benefits.heading: 4 Layers of Continuous Protection
benefits.body: Each layer peels away individually when damaged — the remaining layers keep protecting the glass. One installation handles multiple incidents without re-installation between events.

benefits.heading: On-Site Layer Removal — No Service Call Required
benefits.body: For facilities with trained staff, individual layer removal can be handled on-site without scheduling a contractor. This dramatically reduces the per-incident cost and response time for high-frequency vandalism properties.

benefits.heading: Precision Custom-Cut
benefits.body: Each 4-layer stack is cut to your exact glass dimensions by Graffiti Shield's in-house program. The layers fit precisely with no overhang, ensuring clean edge adhesion and consistent optical appearance across the stack.

name: Metal Shield — Stainless Steel
shortDescription: Thick protective film that replicates stainless steel appearance while absorbing abrasive vandalism on Philadelphia elevator interiors and metal partitions.
description:
Metal Shield in Stainless Steel finish is Graffiti Shield's solution for protecting brushed stainless steel surfaces in Philadelphia's high-traffic commercial environments. The thick anti-graffiti abatement film accurately replicates the visual appearance of brushed stainless steel — in normal lighting and at normal viewing distances, the film is indistinguishable from the original metal surface. When the film absorbs scratching, carving, or chemical attack, it peels cleanly away and a fresh sheet restores the surface to like-new condition without replacing the underlying metal.

Elevator interiors represent the highest-value application for Metal Shield in Philadelphia office towers, hospitality properties, and transit facilities. Stainless steel elevator cab panels in Center City high-rises, SEPTA station elevator interiors, and hotel lobby elevators along the Benjamin Franklin Parkway face repeated vandalism that historically required expensive panel resurfacing or replacement. Metal Shield eliminates that cost entirely by making the film the expendable layer rather than the panel itself.

The film also covers stainless steel partitions, push plates, kick plates, door frames, and any flat or lightly curved stainless surface that experiences abrasive vandalism. For Philadelphia restaurants and bars on Passyunk Avenue, Old City, and Rittenhouse Square, Metal Shield on restroom stainless surfaces and commercial kitchen surrounds removes a recurring maintenance cost that most operators simply accept as unavoidable.

Installation is performed by Window Film Philadelphia's certified team, who assess the metal surface condition, profile, and dimensions before cutting and applying the film.

benefits.heading: Indistinguishable from Real Stainless Steel
benefits.body: Metal Shield Stainless Steel finish accurately replicates the visual appearance of brushed stainless steel under normal lighting. Tenants, guests, and visitors will not notice the protective film is installed.

benefits.heading: Eliminates Elevator Panel Restoration Budget
benefits.body: For Philadelphia office towers and hospitality properties, Metal Shield removes the recurring cost of elevator cab panel resurfacing and replacement — one of the most frequently overlooked maintenance line items in high-rise operations.

benefits.heading: Peels Away Clean — Metal Never Damaged
benefits.body: When the film absorbs vandalism, it peels away cleanly and a fresh sheet is installed. The original stainless steel panel beneath remains undamaged throughout the film's service life.

name: Metal Shield — Brushed Aluminum
shortDescription: Protective film in brushed aluminum finish for Philadelphia aluminum cladding, signage frames, and storefront metalwork vulnerable to abrasive vandalism.
description:
Metal Shield in Brushed Aluminum finish protects aluminum-finished surfaces throughout Philadelphia's commercial environment. The film replicates the matte silver appearance of brushed aluminum while absorbing scratching, scoring, and abrasive damage that would otherwise require panel refinishing or replacement. For Philadelphia retail storefronts with aluminum window frames and signage surrounds on Walnut Street, Chestnut Street, and in Center City's retail corridors, Metal Shield provides continuous protection against the low-level abrasive vandalism that accumulates unnoticed over months.

Aluminum surfaces in Philadelphia present a specific maintenance challenge: the anodized or brushed finish is durable under normal use but highly susceptible to permanent scratch marking from keys, coins, and abrasive tools. Once scratched through the surface treatment, aluminum panels cannot be refinished in place — replacement is the only option. Metal Shield Brushed Aluminum intercepts this damage cycle by presenting a replaceable film surface rather than the panel itself.

Typical Philadelphia applications include aluminum storefront frames on retail and restaurant ground floors, aluminum-clad building entrance surrounds in Center City office towers, interior aluminum column cladding in commercial lobbies, and aluminum-finish door hardware surrounds in high-traffic public spaces. The film handles the flat and lightly curved profiles typical of architectural aluminum applications.

Window Film Philadelphia assesses the aluminum surface dimensions, profile, and condition before installation to ensure proper fit and adhesion across the full coverage area.

benefits.heading: Protects Anodized Aluminum from Permanent Scratch Damage
benefits.body: Anodized and brushed aluminum surfaces cannot be refinished in place once scratched through. Metal Shield creates a sacrificial layer that absorbs abrasive damage while leaving the aluminum panel beneath untouched.

benefits.heading: Accurate Brushed Aluminum Appearance
benefits.body: The film's brushed aluminum finish replicates the surface appearance of architectural aluminum accurately. In normal use, the protective film is not visually distinguishable from the original metal surface.

benefits.heading: Covers Frames, Surrounds, and Cladding
benefits.body: Metal Shield Brushed Aluminum covers the full range of architectural aluminum surfaces in Philadelphia commercial buildings — storefront frames, entrance surrounds, lobby column cladding, and door hardware frames.

name: Metal Shield — Brushed Gold
shortDescription: Sacrificial protective film in brushed gold finish for Philadelphia hospitality and luxury retail decorative metal fixtures targeted by vandalism.
description:
Metal Shield in Brushed Gold finish is Graffiti Shield's protective solution for decorative gold-toned metal surfaces in Philadelphia hospitality, luxury retail, and high-end commercial environments. The film accurately replicates the warm, matte appearance of brushed gold metalwork — the kind found on elevator cab interiors, hotel lobby fixtures, restaurant bar surrounds, and high-end retail environments throughout Center City and the Benjamin Franklin Parkway corridor.

Gold-toned decorative metal fixtures represent a particularly expensive vandalism target. Unlike stainless steel or aluminum, brushed gold finishes are often PVD-coated or anodized brass, materials for which in-place refinishing is cost-prohibitive or simply unavailable. When these surfaces are scratched or etched, the only options are expensive specialist restoration or full replacement — both of which interrupt operations and require specialist contractors. Metal Shield Brushed Gold eliminates this scenario entirely.

Typical Philadelphia applications include elevator cab interiors in boutique hotels along Rittenhouse Square and in the Midtown Village hospitality corridor, decorative metal fixtures in high-end restaurants and cocktail bars, gold-finish door hardware and push plates in luxury retail environments on Walnut Street, and ornamental metalwork in upscale commercial lobbies throughout Center City.

The film is installed by Window Film Philadelphia's certified team, who assess the fixture surface profile, dimensions, and condition. Most decorative metal fixture installations are completed in a single service visit with no disruption to hotel or restaurant operations.

benefits.heading: Protects Irreplaceable Decorative Metalwork
benefits.body: PVD-coated and anodized brass fixtures cannot be refinished in place. Metal Shield Brushed Gold intercepts vandalism before it reaches the original surface, eliminating costly restoration or replacement.

benefits.heading: Accurate Gold Finish — Invisible in Normal Use
benefits.body: The film's brushed gold tone replicates decorative gold metalwork accurately under normal hospitality and retail lighting. Guests and customers will not detect the protective film in regular use.

benefits.heading: No Operations Disruption
benefits.body: Most decorative metal fixture installations are completed in a single visit without disrupting hotel, restaurant, or retail operations. Film replacement after vandalism is similarly non-disruptive.

name: Mirror Shield
shortDescription: Sacrificial protective film for Philadelphia restroom mirrors — maintains full reflective appearance while absorbing scratching, etching, and spray paint.
description:
Mirror Shield is Graffiti Shield's dedicated sacrificial protective film for mirror surfaces. It maintains the full reflective appearance of mirrors while providing a protective layer that absorbs scratches, acid etching, spray paint, and marker vandalism. When the film is damaged — whether immediately visible or only discovered during routine inspection — the damaged layer peels away cleanly and a fresh sheet is installed, restoring the mirror to like-new reflective quality without replacing the glass behind it.

Restroom mirrors are among the most frequently vandalized surfaces in Philadelphia restaurants, bars, event venues, and transit facilities. They are also among the most expensive and operationally disruptive to replace. A full-width vanity mirror in a Philadelphia restaurant restroom represents not only material cost but layout disruption and downtime during replacement. Mirror Shield eliminates the replacement entirely — the film is the expendable layer, the mirror glass is protected indefinitely.

As Graffiti Shield Inc. describes the product: it is "designed to resist scratching, etching, and other forms of graffiti" while "maintaining the reflective appearance of mirrors" and "prolonging their lifespan and functionality." For operators in Old City, Passyunk Avenue, and Fishtown — neighborhoods where high-volume Friday and Saturday evening service means restroom mirrors face concentrated vandalism risk — Mirror Shield fundamentally changes the maintenance calculus.

Mirror Shield is also specified for fitting room mirrors in retail environments, locker room mirrors in Philadelphia athletic and recreational facilities, and decorative mirrors in hotel corridors and lobbies throughout Center City.

benefits.heading: Full Reflective Appearance Preserved
benefits.body: Mirror Shield maintains the complete reflective quality of the mirror beneath. Users see a normal, undistorted reflection — the protective film is invisible in normal use.

benefits.heading: Eliminates Mirror Replacement Cost and Disruption
benefits.body: When Mirror Shield is damaged, only the film is replaced. The mirror glass remains intact. For Philadelphia restaurant and venue operators, this removes a recurring cost that most accept as inevitable.

benefits.heading: Designed for High-Traffic Restroom Environments
benefits.body: Mirror Shield is engineered for the moisture, cleaning product exposure, and repeated use patterns of commercial restroom environments throughout Philadelphia's hospitality corridor.

name: Custom Shield
shortDescription: Patent-pending protective films tailored to unconventional substrates — stone facades, painted brick, specialty cladding — in Philadelphia's diverse architectural environments.
description:
Custom Shield is Graffiti Shield's patent-pending line of protective products specifically engineered for substrates where standard glass or metal films do not apply. Stone facades, painted brick, specialty architectural cladding, non-standard surfaces, and materials that require a substrate-matched protective layer are all within Custom Shield's scope. The product either mimics the appearance of the underlying surface or provides direct protective coverage, depending on the specific application.

Philadelphia's architectural diversity makes Custom Shield particularly relevant to the city's property owners. Old City and Society Hill feature historic stone facades and painted brick that are frequent targets of spray paint and marker vandalism. The Benjamin Franklin Parkway corridor and Penn's Landing waterfront area include specialty cladding and architectural surfaces for which standard film products offer no direct solution. Fishtown and Northern Liberties mixed-use developments often incorporate raw concrete, exposed masonry, and specialty finish materials that face vandalism pressure without existing protective options.

Custom Shield engagements begin with an in-person assessment by Window Film Philadelphia, during which we document the substrate material, surface profile, finish appearance, and vandalism history. This assessment is provided to Graffiti Shield for product specification. Each Custom Shield application is evaluated and specified individually — there is no catalog product; each deployment is engineered to the specific surface.

For historic Philadelphia properties where preservation guidelines restrict permanent surface alteration, Custom Shield's non-permanent application method may provide a pathway to vandalism protection that standard coatings or paints cannot offer. We assess compatibility with historic preservation requirements as part of the site evaluation.

benefits.heading: Protection for Surfaces That Standard Films Don't Cover
benefits.body: Custom Shield extends Graffiti Shield's sacrificial film system to stone, painted brick, specialty cladding, and non-standard architectural surfaces — substrates for which no off-the-shelf anti-graffiti film has historically been available.

benefits.heading: Patent-Pending Substrate-Matched Technology
benefits.body: Custom Shield uses Graffiti Shield's patent-pending process to create a film that either replicates the visual appearance of the underlying surface or provides direct protective coverage — tailored to each specific substrate and application.

benefits.heading: Compatible with Historic Preservation Requirements
benefits.body: For Philadelphia's historic buildings in Old City, Society Hill, and Chestnut Hill, Custom Shield's non-permanent application may be compatible with preservation guidelines that restrict permanent surface alteration. We evaluate compatibility as part of the site assessment.

specs.substrate: Stone, brick, specialty cladding, non-standard surfaces

name: Printed Films
shortDescription: Custom-printed anti-graffiti films that combine surface protection with branding, advertising, and graphics — replace design and renew protection in one step.
description:
Graffiti Shield's Printed Films combine anti-graffiti surface protection with full-color custom graphics produced by Graffiti Shield's in-house printing program. Rather than treating vandalism protection and surface presentation as separate programs with separate schedules and contractors, Printed Films consolidate both into a single replaceable film layer applied to glass. When the film is damaged by vandalism or when the graphic campaign changes, the entire layer is removed and replaced — simultaneously renewing the protection and updating the design.

For Philadelphia retail storefronts on Walnut Street, Chestnut Street, and South Street, Printed Films enable a combination of anti-graffiti protection and seasonal or promotional window graphics that would otherwise require two separate products and two separate service relationships. A Printed Film installation for a spring campaign provides anti-graffiti protection through the season; when the campaign ends, the film is replaced with a new design rather than removed entirely.

Philadelphia transit advertising applications are a strong fit for Printed Films. SEPTA advertising panels and platform barriers that currently require separate graphic media and separate anti-graffiti protection can be consolidated into a single Printed Film layer. When advertising campaigns change, the film replacement serves double duty as a protection renewal.

As Graffiti Shield Inc. describes the product: operators can "convey messages to customers and employees, advertise new products, or add a thematic touch" while "turning surface protection into a creative marketing avenue." The in-house printing ensures color accuracy and material compatibility with the anti-graffiti coating system — the graphic layer and the protective hard coat are integrated in the manufacturing process rather than applied separately.

benefits.heading: Protection and Branding in One Layer
benefits.body: Printed Films replace two separate products — anti-graffiti film and window graphics — with a single layer that provides both simultaneously. One installation, one service relationship, one replacement cycle.

benefits.heading: Replace Design and Renew Protection Together
benefits.body: When the graphic campaign changes, the Printed Film is replaced — automatically renewing the anti-graffiti protection as part of the same service event. Campaigns end; protection is always current.

benefits.heading: In-House Printing Ensures Integration
benefits.body: Graffiti Shield produces Printed Films in-house, integrating the graphic layer with the anti-graffiti coating system in manufacturing. Color accuracy, material compatibility, and protective performance are built into the film rather than stacked on top of each other.
